notes: Mirrors the reference: zip names are suffixed before root filtering, squashfs objects carry the link target (with an error on missing stat info), NewObject tries the exact name before the translated one, and copy and escape tests are solid.

Works and handles name collisions, but adds unrequested lenient matching of unsuffixed roots through a hard-to-read mixed &&/|| expression and an extra pre-pass, and its squashfs New retry can misresolve a directory root to a sibling 'x.rclonelink' file.

A clean fix close to the reference: squashfs lookup checks the exact name first and then the translated link name, and the extra zip NewObject tweak that prefers a regular member on a name clash is a small, reasonable addition backed by thorough tests, including the hostile copy.

Adds unrequested pruning of zip members below symlinks and a costly per-call squashfs hasSymlinkAncestor walk, and it skips the suffix for zip symlinks whose names already end in .rclonelink, so they would copy out under the wrong name; it fails one hidden test.

The zip side is correct, but squashfs NewObject always strips the .rclonelink suffix when --links is set, so a regular member named 'x.rclonelink' can no longer be found; this breaks an explicit requirement, and the candidate's own test fails on it.
